$comment: WLED in its MQTT mode, over the hub's own broker (issue #72), run by the GENERIC mqtt adapter. The plain wled template (HTTP + WebSocket) needs no broker; this one is for WLED set up to report by MQTT. Format: wiki Device-Templates.
name: WLED light (MQTT)
description: LED strips and lamps running WLED, connected to the hub's MQTT broker: changes show up at once.

inputs.label: Topic
inputs.hint: A short name for the light's messages, e.g. kitchen_strip (letters, digits, - and _)

steps.hint: Making the light's own login on the hub…

errors.timeout: The light hasn't connected to the hub yet. Check WLED's MQTT settings (broker, username, password, device topic) and that it's on the same WiFi.
